done.title: Stealth mode with WebDriver detection evasion
Connection pooling with warm browser instances
Request interception for blocking and modification
HAR network capture for session recording
File download handling with download directory and retrieval endpoint
Page interaction actions: click, type, select, hover, waitForSelector
Session timeout with auto-cleanup of idle sessions
Target specific sessions by ID via X-Session-Id header or query param
Custom user-agent and viewport emulation per session
Browser fingerprint randomization for advanced anti-detection
File upload handling for form file inputs
TypeScript SDK client library for the Anvil Engine API
Webhook callbacks for session lifecycle events

log.description: Initial engine: launcher.ts, session.ts, cdp-proxy.ts, api.ts (7 endpoints + graceful shutdown)
Implemented POST /v1/scrape: navigate, waitForSelector, extract html/text
Implemented POST /v1/pdf: optional URL, format, landscape, binary response
Implemented GET/POST /v1/cookies: extract and inject cookies
Implemented stealth mode: anti-detection Chrome flags, default enabled
Created Dockerfile + .dockerignore for containerized deployment
Implemented BrowserPool: init/acquire/release/shutdown, ANVIL_POOL_SIZE env
Implemented authenticated proxy: URL parsing, ProxyCredentials, page.authenticate()
Implemented POST /v1/intercept: blockPatterns substring match, enable/disable
Implemented HAR capture: start/stop/get, per-session harStore, page.on('response')

Implemented file download: per-session temp dir, Chrome --download-default-directory, GET /v1/downloads (list) + GET /v1/downloads/:filename (binary stream), path traversal protection, cleanup on destroy. 17 endpoints total.

23 tests for file download: list/retrieve endpoint contracts, path traversal protection (reject .., /, \), URI decoding, download dir lifecycle (create/list/cleanup/stat), BrowserProcess.downloadDir integration, Chrome flag format. 88 total.
feat-file-download: correct path traversal defense (reject + basename), graceful error fallbacks, proper cleanup on destroy, Content-Disposition headers, 23 tests. Approved.
Designed page interaction actions: 5 new endpoints (click, type, select, hover, wait) using withBrowser helper, selector validation, optional params for button/delay/timeout.

Implemented 5 page action endpoints: click (button/clickCount), type (text/delay), select (multi-value), hover, wait (timeout 10s default). All use withBrowser, validate selector, return {success, selector}. 22 endpoints total.

30 tests for page actions: click (selector/button/clickCount/defaults), type (selector/text/delay), select (values array/single/multi), hover (selector), wait (timeout default 10s), shared contract (5 endpoints, error format, withBrowser). 118 total.
feat-page-actions: correct selector validation, safe puppeteer delegation, withBrowser guarantees disconnect, proper defaults, 30 tests. Approved.
Designed API key authentication: ANVIL_API_KEY env var, Bearer token validation, 401 on failure, skip when unset (dev mode), exempt OPTIONS for CORS.
Implemented API key auth: ANVIL_API_KEY env, Bearer token check before route matching, 401 on failure, skip when unset, OPTIONS exempt, startup log shows auth mode.

20 tests for API key auth: env var behavior (empty=disabled, set=enabled), header validation (Bearer format, wrong/missing/partial/correct), 401 response shape, OPTIONS exemption, dev mode passthrough, startup logging, check ordering. 138 total.

feat-api-key-auth: correct exact-match Bearer comparison, no key leakage in logs/responses, OPTIONS exempt, auth before routing, 20 tests. Timing side-channel noted but acceptable for internal use. Approved.
Designed session timeout: ANVIL_SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS env (default 5min), lastActivityAt tracking, 30s cleanup interval, auto-destroy idle sessions, timeout info in health/session responses.

Implemented session timeout: lastActivityAt on Session, touch() on every request, startCleanup()/stopCleanup() with 30s interval, timeout info in GET /v1/sessions (timeoutMs/idleMs/expiresAt) and GET /v1/health (sessionTimeoutMs), ANVIL_SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS env (default 5min).

23 tests for session timeout: lastActivityAt field, touch() method (exists/no-throw on missing), startCleanup (0/negative/positive), stopCleanup (idempotent), env var defaults/overrides, session response shape (timeoutMs/idleMs/expiresAt), health response (sessionTimeoutMs), cleanup interval logic. 161 total.

feat-session-timeout: correct touch/cleanup logic, proper interval management, stopCleanup on shutdown, timeout info in responses, 23 tests. Note: || 300000 prevents env=0 from disabling — minor, non-blocking. Approved.
Designed multi-session targeting: X-Session-Id header or ?sessionId= query param, resolveSession() helper, 404 on missing explicit ID, backward-compat fallback to getActive(), touch targeted session.

Implemented session targeting: resolveSession() helper (X-Session-Id header > ?sessionId param > getActive()), 404 on missing explicit ID vs 400 on no active. Replaced all 18 getActive() calls in endpoints. Touch targets resolved session. Health reports multiSession: true.

19 tests for session targeting: X-Session-Id header resolution, ?sessionId query param, header precedence, fallback to getActive(), 404 vs 400 differentiation, resolveSession result type (discriminated union), 18 endpoints listed, touch on targeted, health multiSession, backward compat. 180 total.

feat-session-targeting: correct priority (header > param > fallback), discriminated union type-safe, no injection risk (UUID Map lookup), 404/400 semantics correct, backward compat preserved, 19 tests. Approved.

Migrated 5 endpoints (pdf, cookies GET/POST, evaluate, screenshot) from raw puppeteer.connect to withBrowser helper — guarantees disconnect on error. Only HAR start + intercept remain raw (intentionally: persistent listeners).

Designed custom user-agent + viewport emulation per session: userAgent in LaunchOptions/body, page.setUserAgent on connect, page.setViewport for dimensions, GET /v1/sessions/:id for session details, reported in session response.

Implemented userAgent + viewport: userAgent in LaunchOptions, passed from POST /v1/sessions body, applied via page.setUserAgent + page.setViewport on creation, reported in response. New GET /v1/sessions/:id endpoint with full session details. 23 endpoints total.

18 tests for userAgent/viewport: body acceptance, optional/backward-compat, response shape (set/null), LaunchOptions field, viewport defaults/overrides, GET /v1/sessions/:id (404/details/URL pattern/list exclusion), setUserAgent conditional, backward compat. 198 total.
feat-useragent-viewport: correct setUserAgent/setViewport in withBrowser, optional field with null default, GET /v1/sessions/:id with list exclusion, 18 tests. Approved.

Designed fingerprint randomization: canvas noise, WebGL vendor/renderer, AudioContext offset, navigator props. Deterministic seed per session (consistent within, unique across). evaluateOnNewDocument injection. Gated by stealth mode.

Implemented fingerprint randomization in src/fingerprint.ts: xorshift32 PRNG from session ID seed, canvas toDataURL/toBlob noise, WebGL VENDOR/RENDERER override, navigator.hardwareConcurrency/deviceMemory, AudioContext detune offset. Injected via evaluateOnNewDocument on session create when stealth enabled. Response reports fingerprint: true/false.

25 tests for fingerprint: generateFingerprintScript (export/returns string/different seeds differ/same seed identical/IIFE), canvas overrides (toDataURL/toBlob/createImageData), WebGL (getParameter/WebGL2/37445/37446/GPU variants), navigator (hardwareConcurrency/deviceMemory/values), AudioContext (createOscillator/detune), PRNG (xorshift/seed embed/range), stealth gating. 223 total.

feat-fingerprint-randomization: correct PRNG seeding, proper prototype overrides (canvas/WebGL/navigator/AudioContext), JSON.stringify prevents injection, evaluateOnNewDocument persists across navigations, 25 tests. New-page limitation noted (non-blocking). Approved.
Added request body size limit (1MB) in readBody() — prevents memory exhaustion from oversized payloads. Added 100KB script size cap on /v1/actions/evaluate. req.destroy() on overflow.

Designed file upload: POST /v1/actions/upload with selector + filename + base64 data. Write to temp, page.uploadFile(), cleanup after. 10MB data limit, path traversal rejection, reuses session downloadDir.

Implemented POST /v1/actions/upload: validate selector/filename/data, reject path traversal, decode base64, enforce 10MB limit, write temp file to downloadDir, page.$(selector).uploadFile(), cleanup in finally block. 24 endpoints total.

19 tests for file upload: input validation (selector/filename/data/session), path traversal protection (../slash/backslash/safe names), base64 decode + 10MB limit, temp file handling (basename/finally cleanup/no-dir error), success response shape, element-not-found error, request body contract. 242 total.
feat-file-upload: correct path traversal defense + basename, base64 decode before size check, withBrowser for safe disconnect, finally cleanup of temp file, 10MB limit, 19 tests. Approved.

Designed TypeScript SDK client: AnvilClient class wrapping all 24 endpoints with typed methods, native fetch, X-Session-Id targeting, Bearer auth, error throwing on non-2xx. Zero dependencies, separate entrypoint.

Implemented AnvilClient in src/client.ts: 24 typed methods (createSession/release/navigate/click/type/select/hover/wait/evaluate/upload/scrape/pdf/screenshot/cookies/har/intercept/downloads), native fetch, Bearer auth, X-Session-Id targeting, throws on error. Exported as ./client in package.json.

31 tests for SDK client: constructor (baseUrl/apiKey/trailing slash), session lifecycle (6 methods), action methods (8), content methods (5), network methods (4), file methods (2), method count verification (25 total), exports (named export + interface). 273 total.
feat-sdk-client: clean generic request<T> method, correct URL construction, proper auth/session header injection, JSON/binary response handling, good TypeScript ergonomics, 31 tests. Approved.
Improved error handler: catch-all now returns 413 for body-too-large errors and 404 for not-found errors instead of blanket 500. Semantic HTTP status codes for better client-side error handling.

Added 30s acquisition timeout to BrowserPool.acquire() via Promise.race. Prevents request hang when Chrome fails to launch (common in low-resource Docker). Returns clear 'Browser launch timed out' error.

Updated integration tests: full 25-endpoint registry (was 11), updated session lifecycle to 5 (added :id), added client SDK module tests (export, instantiation), fingerprint module export test. 277 total.

Designed webhook callbacks: ANVIL_WEBHOOK_URL env, fire-and-forget POST on session.created/released/timed_out, 5s AbortController timeout, payload {event, sessionId, timestamp}, errors logged not thrown.

Implemented webhooks in src/webhooks.ts: fireWebhook(event, sessionId) with ANVIL_WEBHOOK_URL env, 5s AbortController timeout, fire-and-forget. Integrated at session create, release, and timeout cleanup. Errors logged to stderr.

19 tests for webhooks: fireWebhook (export/params/void return/no-throw), WebhookEvent type (3 events), env var (empty=disabled/set=enabled), payload shape (event/sessionId/timestamp/JSON-serializable), timeout/AbortController, integration points (create/release/timeout). 296 total.
feat-webhooks: correct fire-and-forget pattern, AbortController cleanup in finally, non-blocking at all 3 integration points, no sensitive data in payload, 19 tests. Approved.
Added structured request logging: every non-OPTIONS request logs method, path, status code, and duration (ms) to stderr on response finish. Essential for production debugging and latency monitoring.
Designed rate limiting: token bucket per-IP, ANVIL_RATE_LIMIT_RPM env (0=disabled), 429 + Retry-After header, stale bucket cleanup every 60s, health endpoint exempt.

Implemented rate limiting in src/rate-limiter.ts: RateLimiter class with token bucket (refill at rpm/60/s, burst=rpm), consume(clientId) returns allowed+retryAfterSec. Integrated before auth, per-IP (X-Forwarded-For), 429+Retry-After, health exempt, cleanup start/stop on init/shutdown.

22 tests for rate limiting: RateLimiter class (construct/consume/allow/reject/retryAfterSec), per-client isolation, token refill (burst=rpm, rate=rpm/60), startCleanup/stopCleanup (idempotent, stale threshold), env var (0=null), 429 response (error msg/Retry-After/health exempt), IP resolution (XFF/remote/unknown). 318 total.
